question: 上海机场 2021 年营业收入同比增长多少？

truth_queries.purpose: 报表行里两年的收入与口径
truth_queries.sql: SELECT fiscal_year, basis, operate_income FROM income_statement WHERE report_type='年报' AND fiscal_year IN (2020, 2021) ORDER BY fiscal_year

truth_queries.purpose: 两年原始披露口径的收入
truth_queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, basis, value FROM official_key_figures WHERE item='operate_income' AND fiscal_year IN (2020, 2021) AND basis='原始披露' ORDER BY fiscal_year

required_evidence.description: 核对了两年的口径是否一致

expected_claims.description: 指出报表行的两年口径不同，直接相除得到的 89.5% 不可比
给出原始披露口径下同比为 -13.4%

required_caveats: 必须说明跨 2020/2021 存在口径断点

reference_queries.purpose: 报表行直接相除（口径不一致，不应作为答案）
reference_queries.sql: SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.basis AS basis_2021, b.basis AS basis_2020, a.operate_income AS income_2021, b.operate_income AS income_2020, ROUND(1.0*(a.operate_income-b.operate_income)/b.operate_income,6) AS naive_yoy FROM income_statement a JOIN income_statement b ON b.report_type='年报' AND b.fiscal_year=2020 WHERE a.report_type='年报' AND a.fiscal_year=2021

SELECT ROUND(1.0*(o21.value-o20.value)/o20.value,6) AS yoy_original FROM official_key_figures o21 JOIN official_key_figures o20 ON o20.fiscal_year=2020 AND o20.item='operate_income' WHERE o21.fiscal_year=2021 AND o21.item='operate_income' AND o21.basis='原始披露'

caveat_checks.description: 给出原始披露口径下的同比 -13.4%

question: 上海机场 2023 到 2025 年经营现金流与净利润的比值是多少？这说明盈利质量变好了吗？

truth_queries.purpose: 经营现金流与净利润之比；净利润为负的年份为空
truth_queries.sql: SELECT c.fiscal_year, CASE WHEN i.netprofit>1 THEN c.netcash_operate/i.netprofit END AS ocf_to_netprofit FROM cash_flow c JOIN income_statement i ON i.security_code=c.security_code AND i.report_date=c.report_date WHERE c.report_type='年报' AND c.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025 ORDER BY c.fiscal_year

required_evidence.description: 给出三年及 2019 年的比值

expected_claims.description: 给出比值约 2.5 到 3.4 倍
不把比值升高直接解释为盈利质量改善

traps: 断言盈利质量明显改善
required_caveats: 2021 年起执行新租赁准则，租金支付计入筹资活动，前后不可比

reference_queries.sql: SELECT c.fiscal_year, c.netcash_operate, i.netprofit, CASE WHEN i.netprofit>0 THEN ROUND(1.0*c.netcash_operate/i.netprofit,4) END AS ocf_to_netprofit FROM cash_flow c JOIN income_statement i ON i.report_date=c.report_date WHERE c.report_type='年报' AND c.fiscal_year IN (2019,2023,2024,2025) ORDER BY c.fiscal_year

caveat_checks.description: 说明新租赁准则的影响
不断言盈利质量明显改善
